name: Privacy Export Reviewer
summary: Redacts PII entity mentions from free text before it leaves a privacy boundary, such as a third-party export or a forwarded support ticket.
description: Needs person, organization, and location mentions blanked out of free text before it is shared outside its original system -- a support ticket forwarded to a vendor, a document exported for a partner, a transcript shared with an auditor. Wants a deterministic-per-call redaction pass rather than raw entity spans, so the caller doesn't have to re-implement span-substitution logic on top of a generic entity extractor.

distinguished_from.how: Needs entity spans blanked out of the text itself for export, rather than a governed per-item outcome state derived from scored evidence.
Redacts specific PII mentions within text that is still being kept, rather than deciding whether a whole asset must be preserved or is eligible for deletion.
